name: Making Choices
overview: Scripture clearly presents making choices as a vital responsibility, emphasizing the consequences tied to those decisions. God sets before us life and death, urging us to choose life so that we and future generations may flourish, as seen in Deuteronomy 30:19. The call to deliberate service, exemplified in Joshua 24:15, challenges believers to decide whom they will serve, affirming a commitment to the LORD. Wisdom literature further instructs reliance on God's guidance rather than human understanding, warning that paths that seem right to man can lead to death, while the LORD directs the steps of those who trust Him.
